spans.text: - generic: For anyone dealing with spider mites on their money tree, here's my approach. I take my money tree outside and give it a good rinse with the hose to wash away any eggs or baby spiders that have been munching on the leaves. Later tonight, I'll spray it with neem oil. This has been my routine because, for some reason, money trees seem to attract spiders no matter how much I tidy up around the house.

- generic: Emily Bolton Thanks a lot! I'm confident your money tree will thrive. Just make sure it gets enough indirect sunlight, and don't overwater it.
